name: Kyuden Holdings, Inc.
summary: Kyuden Holdings, Inc., a Japanese enterprise established in Fukuoka City in 1951, operates as a diversified utility company. Its core activities revolve around the generation, transmission, distribution, and sale of electricity, serving both domestic and international markets. The company's operations are structured across key segments, including Power Generation and Sale, Electricity Transmission and Distribution, Other Energy Services, ICT Service, and additional ventures. It utilizes a broad spectrum of energy sources for power production, encompassing nuclear, thermal, hydroelectric, geothermal, internal combustion, wind, solar, poultry dung fuel, and biomass. Beyond electricity, Kyushu Electric Power oversees the full lifecycle of Liquid Natural Gas (LNG), from its procurement, storage, and vaporization to delivery and sale, along with the operation and chartering of LNG carriers. Its industrial division manufactures electrical machinery, specialized equipment, concrete poles, high and low-voltage insulators, and steel structures. The company also provides construction, maintenance, and repair services for power generation infrastructure, alongside the installation and management of electrical measurement equipment and structural steel. The firm's comprehensive service portfolio extends to real estate, covering property acquisition, leasing, management, and associated services like building assessments. It engages in environmental preservation efforts and confidential document recycling. Furthermore, it offers geothermal technical assistance, air cargo transportation, and a wide array of telecommunication solutions, including devices, fiber-optic networks, and broadband services. Kyushu Electric Power also provides social services, managing elderly nursing homes, delivering nursing care, and offering temporary staffing and job-placement assistance. Its technology arm develops information systems and computer software, operates data centers, and handles internet website planning and management. Additional services range from heat supply and civil engineering/construction consulting (including design and supervision) to clerical support, investment management, e-sports event planning, golf course operations, and subtitle production for broadcasting, while also holding mining interests.
